findings.fsdQuote: The On Deck row shows up to 50 series.
findings.note: The dashboard loads the On Deck row with a page size of 20.

findings.fsdQuote: A Random button on the library screen opens a randomly chosen series from that library.
findings.note: No random-series button or action exists on the library detail screen or anywhere else in the UI templates.

findings.fsdQuote: The Edit button is shown only to administrators, and the Download button only to administrators and users with the Download role.
findings.note: The Edit button sits inside an isAdmin check.

findings.fsdQuote: Selected text can be read aloud using the device's text-to-speech voice.
findings.note: No text-to-speech or speech synthesis code exists in the book reader.

findings.fsdQuote: Kavita removes a series from Want to Read automatically as soon as the user finishes reading it.
findings.note: Removal is done by a recurring cleanup task (RemoveFromWantToRead), not immediately on finishing.
A Browse Genres screen exists, but the FSD describes only People and Tags under Browse.
An All Annotations screen exists under Browse, but the FSD does not describe it.

findings.fsdQuote: The People screen lists people with the number of series and issues each appears in, along with a filter panel and a jump bar, and clicking a person opens that person's page.
findings.note: A People browse route renders BrowsePeopleComponent. This match is based on the route only. I did not read the component for the counts, filter panel or jump bar.

findings.fsdQuote: The Tags screen lists every tag with the number of series and issues that carry it
findings.note: A Tags browse route renders the BrowseTagsComponent.

findings.fsdQuote: Users can turn on two-factor sign-in with an authenticator app.
findings.note: No two-factor option exists in the user settings UI.

findings.fsdQuote: A new password must be at least 8 characters long.
findings.note: The server requires a minimum password length of 6, not 8.

findings.fsdQuote: When Prompt on Download is on, Kavita asks for confirmation before any download larger than 500 MB.
findings.note: The code's download size confirmation threshold is documented as 100 MB, not 500 MB.

findings.fsdQuote: Prompt for Re-Reads sets after how many days without progress Kavita offers to re-read, and 0 turns the prompt off.
findings.note: A promptForRereadsAfter number setting exists with a minimum of 0.

findings.fsdQuote: A maintenance mode switch blocks all non-admin users from signing in until it is turned off.
findings.note: The settings page has no maintenance mode switch. The only maintenance reference in the UI is in the message hub service.

findings.fsdQuote: Changes on this page are stored only when the administrator presses Save.
findings.note: The General page has no Save button. Valid changes are autosaved after a 300 ms debounce.

findings.fsdQuote: Days of Backups and Days of Logs each accept a value from 1 to 30
findings.note: Form validators enforce min 1 and max 30 on both total backups and total logs.

findings.fsdQuote: Cache Size must be at least 50 MB
findings.note: A minimum of 50 is enforced on cache size.

findings.fsdQuote: the base URL must start and end with a slash
findings.note: The base URL pattern requires a leading and trailing slash.

findings.fsdQuote: A Reset to Default button restores these settings after a confirmation.
findings.note: The Reset to Default button asks for confirmation, then resets the server settings.

findings.fsdQuote: Days of Backups and Days of Logs each accept a value from 1 to 30 and both default to 30.
findings.note: The server rejects Days of Backups and Days of Logs values above 30 or below 1. I did not read the default of 30, so only the range is confirmed.

findings.fsdQuote: An invite can be given an expiry date, after which its link stops working.
findings.note: The admin UI has no invite expiry option. Expiry references there concern licenses only.

findings.fsdQuote: Manage Collections is turned on by default for a new library.
findings.note: The new-library form defaults manageCollections to false.

findings.fsdQuote: Include in Dashboard and Include in Search are turned on by default.
findings.note: Both includeInDashboard and includeInSearch default to true.

findings.fsdQuote: | Manga | Archive, Image |
findings.note: Manga defaults to the Archive and Images file groups.

findings.fsdQuote: | Book | Pdf, Epub |
findings.note: Book defaults to the Pdf and Epub file groups.

findings.fsdQuote: | Light Novel | Epub |
findings.note: Light Novel defaults to the Epub file group.
A Genres browse screen lists genres. The FSD describes only People and Tags under Browse.
An All Annotations browse screen exists and is not described in the FSD.
